title: High-Throughput Stratum-Cache Ring Buffer Pattern: Lock-Free Invariants and AST-Based Complexity Analysis in Python
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We present a high-throughput stratum-cache ring buffer pattern tailored for Python concurrency. The pattern decouples producer and consumer flows by maintaining a bounded circular buffer whose state is governed by a lock-free invariant set. We formalize the buffer's capacity, head, tail, and count variables, and prove that all operations preserve sequential consistency. Static analysis of the source yields an $O(1)$ amortized complexity for enqueue and dequeue, with contention bounded by $O(P)$ where P is the number of concurrent threads. The design is verified through an AST-based structural profile that confirms a bounded memory footprint of $O(N)$.
